name: OPLS-AA 2024 rubber backbone refits (CAPS refit, QM)
source: CAPS fits to RI-MP2/cc-pVTZ//HF/6-31G** relaxed torsion scans (the OPLS-AA/L level) of rubber backbone fragments

dihedrals.name: CM-CM-CT-CT
dihedrals.comment: CAPS refit (QM) at DLPNO-CCSD(T)/cc-pVTZ (TightPNO)//wB97X-D3/def2-TZVP, joint over the four complete diene scans: RMS cis-polyisoprene 0.44, trans-polyisoprene 0.49, cis-polybutadiene 0.38, polychloroprene 0.56 kcal/mol; OPLS-AA 2024's own CM-CM-CT-CT on the same scans 0.95, 0.75, 1.02, 0.80. (At RI-MP2/cc-pVTZ//HF/6-31G** the 2024 term looked worse, 1.65 / 1.66 / 1.36 / 0.83, and an MP2 refit made cis-polybutadiene worse against DLPNO, 1.26; this overlay follows the higher level.)

dihedrals.name: CT-CT-CT-CZ
dihedrals.comment: CAPS refit (QM) of NBR's CT-CT-CT-CZ at DLPNO-CCSD(T)/cc-pVTZ//wB97X-D3/def2-TZVP: RMS 0.31 kcal/mol; OPLS-AA 2024's own 0.65

notes: optional overlay on oplsaa2024.json for diene and nitrile rubbers (caps ff apply --overlay oplsaa2024-rubber-refit.json); the base library keeps the 2024 values
